profile_text.body:
Perplexity is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA, USA. The company describes itself as a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question.

Its products include Perplexity AI, a search-augmented LLM, and Perplexity Enterprise Pro, which offers enterprise search AI, internal knowledge search, data indexing, SSO, and audit logs. Two MCP servers are associated with the company: ai.perplexity/mcp-server, which provides real-time web search, reasoning, and research through Perplexity's API, and ai.smithery/arjunkmrm-perplexity-search, which enables AI assistants to perform web searches using Perplexity's Sonar Pro.

Court records list ten cases involving Perplexity AI, Inc. in federal district and appellate courts, with plaintiffs including Sues, Gagleard, Noel, Cable News Network, The New York Times Company, Chicago Tribune Company, Encyclopaedia Britannica, and Amazon.com Services. Court data also lists 281 California-related exposure entries for Perplexity.
